scope: One guarded literal-run admission primitive, two existing original 513x259 RGBA8/16 rasters. All three batching variants rejected. Two inlining diagnostics rejected without timing. No new benchmark image or quality sweep.
productionChange: None. All production bytes match the accepted Work source; no performance improvement is retained. Four reserved-code tests retain exact failure work, atomic failed admission, cancellation fallback and scratch release after valid literal runs.
rejectedPrimitive: PNG strict Deflate framing probes up to eight literal prefixes using local reader state. Only noncancelable operations with enough declared output and fully admitted exact bit work commit a batch. An eight-only variant has no useful gain. Partial runs improve PNG16 but regress PNG8. Starting after an ordinary literal reduces both the gain and regression and remains rejected.
